scope: Read-only audit of job discovery surfaces; no code changes
architectureSummary: Single freshness-first SQL listing pipeline shared across all discovery surfaces. Personalization today is limited to client-side similar-job ranking and resume-fit display pills — neither reorders the main feed.

homeFeed.description: De facto home feed — marketing landing has no live job list; /jobs is the primary browse entry with client-side hydration (SSR returns empty list to avoid timeouts)
homeFeed.freshnessWeighting: Deterministic recency stack — not exponential decay. Stored freshnessScore (exp decay λ=0.08) computed at ingest but NOT used for listing ORDER BY
homeFeed.seoOrdering: JSON-LD ItemList uses first 10 jobs in API order; root /jobs not SSR-populated

personalizationInsertionPoints.scope: Authenticated users only (capCtx.internalUserId != null, not bypassCap)
personalizationInsertionPoints.rationale: Post-fetch re-rank before response; anon/SEO paths unchanged

personalizationInsertionPoints.scope: Client display re-rank behind feature flag
personalizationInsertionPoints.rationale: Optional 'Sort by match' toggle; preserves server order for SEO/crawlers

rankingSignals: salary_desc: salaryMin DESC NULLS LAST → createdAt → id
jobsPage.freshnessWeighting: Optional postedWithin filter (24h/3d/1w/1m) narrows result set; does not change relative order within results
jobsPage.seoOrdering: Canonical URL enforcement via getCanonicalJobListingUrl; decideJobsListingSeoPolicy controls indexability; SEO slug pages use INTERNAL_SEO_SECRET bypass
jobsPage.recommendationLogic: Related SEO slug links ranked by landing-page job count DESC (not job recommendations)
additionalSignals: Filter relevance via buildDiscoveryWhere (hard WHERE, not score)
ResumeScorePill per card (display only, no reorder)
Free-tier view cap / discovery preview (top-N in latest order)

personalizationInsertionPoints.scope: New sort=fit mode behind auth + feature flag
personalizationInsertionPoints.rationale: Central hook; keep latest/salary_desc for SEO

personalizationInsertionPoints.scope: Implicit profile filters for authenticated search
personalizationInsertionPoints.rationale: Must not affect SEO/cached anon responses

searchResults.description: Search IS the jobs listing with query filters — no separate search index
searchResults.rankingLocation: Same SQL pipeline; structured filter matching only
rankingSignals: Taxonomy filters (title, skills, location, category) as hard WHERE
Sort toggle: latest vs salary_desc only
No full-text relevance score in production
searchResults.freshnessWeighting: postedWithin user filter; otherwise same as jobs page
searchResults.seoOrdering: Slug discovery ranked by job count DESC in seo.service.ts
searchResults.recommendationLogic: Related search slugs in footer (count DESC), not job recommendations

personalizationInsertionPoints.approach: Blend resume-fit family boost with freshness for signed-in users

similarJobs.candidatePool: fetchJobs({ category, limit: 20 }) — server latest order within category
similarJobs.ranking: sameRole×3 + sharedSkills×2 + sameCountry×1; tie-break by effectivePostedAt
similarJobs.personalizationInsertion: Add resume family overlap + apply-history boost to rankSimilarJobs

companyJobs.ranking: First 3 in API latest order after filtering current job
companyJobs.personalizationInsertion: Low priority — company context is already narrow

seoHubLinks.personalizationInsertion: Not recommended — SEO navigation must stay deterministic

savedSearchAlerts.personalizationInsertion: Email-only: rank alert jobs by resume fit vs recency

resumeFitPills.ranking: Per-card score display only — does NOT reorder feed

trendingJobs.note: No trending jobs list or API exists

trendingSkillsInResults.ordering: Top skills by frequency in filtered sample (8000-job cap, listingFreshnessAt DESC)

trendingJobs.futureInsertion: New /jobs/trending or sort mode would need new velocity signals (views/applies) — not present today

savedSearches.ordering: Saved search list: createdAt DESC; opening saved search → standard listing pipeline

savedJobs.personalizationInsertion: jobAlerts.worker email selection; future SavedJob model would default to savedAt DESC + optional fit re-rank

availableSignalsForPersonalization: candidateFamily (derived client-side from resumeStructuredV1, currentTitle, applyProfileSummary)
jobFamily (derived client-side from job title, role slug, category)
resume fit score (scoreResume — display only today)

keyQuestions.whereAreJobsRanked: Server SQL in job.repository.ts sqlForCanonicalListingIds; client re-rank only in similarJobsRank.ts
keyQuestions.whatSignalsExist: Freshness stack (active), salary sort (active), stored sourceWeight/freshnessScore (ingest only), rankJobs (dead), resume fit (display only), title families (scoring only)
keyQuestions.whereCanPersonalizationBeInsertedSafely: runMeteredJobsList (auth post-fetch re-rank) is highest-leverage; JobService.list sort=fit is secondary; client toggle is tertiary

conclusion: Feed ranking is freshness-first and identical across home, jobs, and search. Resume Fit V2 scoring is orthogonal to feed order — explaining 93.4% title_mismatch unavailable when users browse cross-domain jobs. Safe personalization insertion is post-fetch re-ranking for authenticated users only.
